response.overview: Struggling with depression and feeling increasingly isolated, a troubled teenager receives an anonymous message inviting him to take part in a mysterious online game. At first, the challenges seem harmless, even intriguing—but as the game progresses, the tasks become increasingly disturbing and questionable.  Unable to break away from the game and desperate to find a sense of purpose, he begins to realize that someone—or something—is watching his every move. As reality and the game slowly begin to blur, he must decide how far he is willing to go before the next challenge becomes impossible to escape
response.tagline: Every game has a price. This one might cost him everything.
response.title: There is no Silver lining
